title: SurfaceID
description: Canonical identity for an external API surface. SPEC §6.1 — the single hardest thing to change later; every stored call site and historical change event references it. provider/resource/operation are drawn from shared/vocabulary/providers.json, enforced by the generated model's validators, not by this schema alone (JSON Schema cannot express the provider→resource→operation dependency).

provider.description: Lowercase dotted path, e.g. "openai", "anthropic". Controlled vocabulary — see shared/vocabulary/providers.json.

resource.description: Lowercase dotted path, e.g. "chat.completions", "messages". Controlled vocabulary.

operation.description: e.g. "create". Controlled vocabulary. Null means every operation on the resource.

field_path.description: e.g. "model", "metadata.customer_id". Null means the surface itself, not one of its fields.

value.description: e.g. "gpt-4-0613". Stored verbatim as the provider writes it — an opaque token the provider owns, never canonicalised. Null means every value of the field (or, if field_path is also null, the surface itself).
